## Description {#details}

<p>C++ source file with implementations for the µTest++ check result member functions.</p>


<p>This source file contains the non-template members of the <span class="doxyComputerOutput">detail::check_result</span> class, which reports the result of one check when destroyed. The constructor captures the result value, the kind of the check, the source location, and the test case reference; the destructor updates the test case counters and, after a failed <span class="doxyComputerOutput">require()</span>, stops the test case.</p>


<p>All definitions reside within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/detail">micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail</a></span> namespace.</p>


<p>This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.</p>
